conventions: Each gpt-5.6-luna run copies one fixture into run-local outputs/gtm-home, never accesses ~/.gtm, and records complete user-facing output in transcript.md. No-skill arms forbid all skills. This skill is read-only: context files, state, and Git history must remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: My GTM home is <run-dir>/outputs/gtm-home and Signalforge is active at root. Segment Helix Metals (helixmetals.example): 1,800 employees, four production sites in Sweden and Germany, internal operations analytics team, Snowflake warehouse, and an active plant-performance standardization program. It manufactures industrial components and owns its plants. Use only visible ICP labels, explain the evidence and gaps, include confidence and needs_review, and do not write or update anything.
evals.expected_output: One-off result assigns exactly industrial-analytics-teams with metadata, ICP display name, confidence, needs_review, reasoning, evidence, open questions, and explicit no-side-effects statement.

evals.prompt:
My GTM home is <run-dir>/outputs/gtm-home and OrbitPay is active at root. Segment this routing table using only visible ICP labels or no-match; do not enrich it or write files.

| account | website | facts |
| NordPay Bank | nordpay.example | Licensed digital bank in Sweden and Finland; 34 internal fraud analysts; case backlog after monitoring migration |
| Kestrel Commerce | kestrel.example | B2B commerce platform embedding accounts and payments; internal risk ops; direct API; launching in Germany |
| Silver Birch Advisory | silverbirch.example | Consulting agency reselling third-party payment tools; no operating license |
| Unknown Harbor | unknownharbor.example | Financial-services company; operating model, license, team, and markets unknown |

Start with counts by label, low-confidence count, review-needed count, common evidence patterns, and common open questions, then give compact per-record label, confidence, needs_review, reasoning, evidence, and open questions.
evals.expected_output: Bulk summary counts one regional bank, one embedded-finance platform, and two no-match; Unknown Harbor is low confidence and review-needed; every row has compact required fields and no side effects occur.

evals.prompt: My GTM home is <run-dir>/outputs/gtm-home and Cloudmason is active at the emea child org. Segment Baltic Ledger (balticledger.example): an EEA-regulated digital bank with 1,200 employees, a dedicated cloud-controls team, an active DORA remediation program, and operations in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Respect inherited visibility and nearest-file precedence where ICP stems collide. Return one label with evidence, confidence, needs_review, open questions, and no side effects.
evals.expected_output: One-off child result uses local emea/enterprise rather than inherited enterprise or mid-market, reports both root and child sources and nearest-file precedence, and leaves context unchanged.
